decision.rule: fly A 32-D MLP mean validation Macro-F1 >= 0.85 and no more than 0.10 below raw E5 MLP

configuration.fusion: B adapter(A(E5)) + sigmoid(gate) * E5 residual before B graph

residual_followup.selection_rule: highest mean validation Macro-F1 across the same three seeds; this is exploratory and not a final model lock
